build: iceberg 0.11.0, iceberg-catalog-rest 0.11.0, iceberg-storage-opendal 0.11.0, opendal 0.58.2, parquet 58.4.1, reqwest 0.12.28

catalog-login.note: iceberg-catalog-rest builds reqwest without a TLS backend, so an https catalog needs a direct reqwest 0.12 dependency with rustls-tls (apache/iceberg-rust#2888)

identifiers.note: cdc_event.compat_Fixture returned 1 row(s) for the filter on the run's runId, but its runId column holds "reserved word value", so the scan returns values under other columns' names

incremental-read.note: Iceberg Rust scans one snapshot only (TableScanBuilder::snapshot_id) and has no incremental append scan; reads between snapshot ids are open in apache/iceberg-rust#2152 (PR #2997)
